atts.title: Prime Gravity
atts.subtitle: An ultra-premium burger atelier shaped by hydro-suspension plating, textural layering, and a grill rhythm that feels engineered rather than served.
atts.heading: h1

atts.label: View ingredients

atts.text: Sauce droplets and sesame seeds move behind the narrative like a live flame line, bending the air around the typography.

atts.title: Built like a production line, plated like a signature dish.
atts.heading: h2

atts.text: Each stage follows the heat, not a grid. The sequence moves as a drip of sauce, with every layer assembled on scroll.

steps.title: Bun, patty, and lacquered edge.
steps.content: A foundation of toasted brioche, precisely seared protein, and a thin glaze of glossy reduction.

steps.title: Surface tension, smoke, and caramelized depth.
steps.content: The crust lands with engineered color, a deep amber edge that signals flavor before the first bite.

steps.title: Crunch, melt, and contrast.
steps.content: Pickle brightness, cheddar melt, onion bite, and sauce density are spaced like a perfectly tuned tasting curve.

steps.title: A slow-motion finish before service.
steps.content: Final assembly is timed to the last ember, keeping the burger vivid, molten, and structurally elegant.

atts.title: Ingredients suspended in a luxury of heat and texture.
atts.subtitle: The room opens into a rhythm of stacked materials: brioche warmth, charcoal edge, molten cheddar, and a clean jalapeño finish that keeps the palette alive.

atts.title: A dining room tuned for texture, heat, and precision.
atts.subtitle: The final sequence settles into a warm, shadowed dining environment where each reservation feels like a backstage pass to the grill.

atts.text: A tactile, high-contrast burger atelier built around heat, structure, and a precise material language that feels plated rather than served.
